title: Codex add project route preview
summary: Use Codex to add a manifest-driven Caddy route preview command, with focused docs and tests, without changing live edge config.

actions.prompt: Add a small manifest-driven route preview path for Cortex project manifests. Prefer extending ops/bin/project_manifest.py with a command that renders deterministic Caddy route preview output from validated manifests into a generated docs artifact or stdout, plus focused docs/tests. Keep scope tight: do not modify bootstrap/compose/edge/*, do not change live routing, and do not touch .codex/config.toml. After editing, run targeted validation/tests for the manifest and route preview path and leave the repo consistent.
